transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I got scared of what I’ve been doing. When I eat too much, I’ve been going to the bathroom and making myself throw up so I won’t gain weight. It’s not just a one-time thing anymore, and that’s what worries me.
How often have you been making yourself throw up after eating too much, and has this been going on for at least once a week for the past three months?

Yes. For the past several months, it’s been happening most weeks. I’ll have one of those eating spells in secret, and then I go and make myself throw up afterward. I can’t really say it’s just occasional anymore.
Besides making yourself throw up, have you been doing anything else like extreme dieting, fasting, excessive exercise, or using laxatives or diet pills to try to control your weight?
I don’t really know what else to say there. The main thing I’ve been doing is making myself throw up after I overeat. I haven’t really kept track of anything beyond that.
When you have these eating spells, do you feel like you can't control how much you're eating or stop yourself from eating even when you want to?

Yes. Once I start during those times, it feels like I’m just on automatic. I’ll be thinking, “I should stop before my husband notices,” but then I’m still reaching for one more thing anyway. It’s like I know I want to stop, but I don’t.
After these eating spells and making yourself throw up, how do you feel about it? Do you feel guilty or distressed about it?

I’m not really sure how to explain it. I don’t feel good about it afterward, but I haven’t really thought through whether it’s guilt exactly. It’s more just… I know it happened, and I try to move on and not dwell on it.
On average, how often have you been making yourself throw up after eating — is it at least once a week?

Yes… it is at least once a week. For the past several months, it’s been most weeks that I have one of those eating spells in secret and then make myself sick afterward. I can’t really call it just occasional anymore.
When you make yourself throw up, is it usually because you feel uncomfortably full after one of those eating spells, or is it for other reasons?

It’s not just because I feel too full. I mean, that’s part of it sometimes, but mostly I do it because I’m scared I’ll gain weight after eating too much. I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up, and it’s happened enough now that I knew I needed to come in.
Can you confirm whether, on average, you’ve been making yourself throw up at least once every week during these past several months?

Yes. For the past several months, it’s been happening most weeks. I’ll have one of those secret eating spells, and then I go make myself throw up afterward. I can’t really say it’s just occasional anymore.
